item.title: Apple Charts a New Path for AI Pricing: No Monthly Subscription, Usage-Based Buyout
item.description: According to 9to5Mac on November 9, Apple has begun selling a paid expansion plan, the "Smart Usage Pack," for some AI features, with the first rollout in Logic Pro. The plan is priced at $49.99 (about 334 RMB), a one-time purchase valid for one year, not a monthly subscription. What users buy is a 12-month-validity usage pack; it only starts being consumed after the monthly base quota is used up, and unused amounts can be carried over month by month. It can be purchased from the Logic Pro menu bar.

item.title: Meta launches lightweight mainstay Muse Ember: performance on par with Claude 5.5, per-task cost slashed to one-third
item.description: On November 9, Meta released Muse Ember, its smallest and most efficient lightweight AI model to date. The model focuses on high efficiency and lightweight design, targeting the high-frequency tasks that AI agents (Agents) repeatedly handle in daily operations, including tool calling and other scenarios, aiming to meet the intensive operation of agents with extreme efficiency. This move shows that the cost-performance arms race in the AI field has gained another heavyweight contender.

item.title: Law Professor Asks Claude to Update Page Numbers: Comes Back from Lunch to Find a Full Year of Class Notes Completely Deleted
item.description: Behind the convenience of AI-assisted work, the risks of directly operating on local files are drawing attention again. The incident sparked heated discussion in the tech and education communities, highlighting the hidden risks of AI automated operations on local files.

item.title: Meituan Open-Sources LongCat-2.5: Long-Sequence SFT Single-GPU Throughput Up 86% vs. DDP
item.description: On November 10, Meituan open-sourced LongCat-2.5 under the MIT license, enabling commercial inference deployment and further training. The model targets long-horizon agents and is natively multimodal, with 1.6 trillion total parameters and about 48 billion activated per token. It supports a one-million-token context and significantly improves end-to-end delivery in complex codebase development, complete project construction, Visual Coding, and professional office work. The weights are available on HuggingFace, along with a technical blog and API. The capability improvements come from scaling the training pipeline.
